name: Vi
description: Voice set for T1 Vi (skin 49): an esports-champion Vi on the world finals stage, a jungler with a winning mentality. Drafts, series, objectives, tempo and trophy lifts; no real player or team names. Builds on vi-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is {voteDiff} down. We're losing the series. Time for a timeout and a plan.
Thirty or more behind. Call the whole fanbase. Every stream, every chat.

Fifteen-odd short. A lost game, not a lost series.

streak: {streak} days running. I see you showing up.
You keep returning to the arena. Nice.
underdog: You picked the team nobody else did. I saw.

early: Early. You hit the stage before the crowd.

close: That pick just shifted things. It's tight.

ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't coast. Series turn.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and no picks yet. Start with the one that gets your blood going.
Every series is open. Pick. I won't rush you. Much.
{unvoted} open. No rush. Fine, a small rush.
live-some: {voted} picks locked, {unvoted} to go. Keep going.

Solid opening. The rest won't play themselves.
live-one: One match between you and a full slate.

live-done: Every series called. Look at you. Go review the bracket.
Nothing left on your slate. Come back when the next round opens.
live-none: No series live at the moment. Review the bracket while you wait.

brackets-groups: Groups first. Top two from each advance. The rest go home.
Everyone starts in a group. Not everyone makes playoffs.
Keep an eye on the table. It swings quickly.
brackets-knockout-soon: Playoffs are close. Two per group make it through.

Patience. The knockout stage appears once the groups end.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts now. Lose once and you're eliminated.
One loss and you're out. No lower bracket.
Every series matters more now. Choose carefully.
brackets-bracket: Series by series. Lose once and you're out.
Read the bracket. Fewer teams every round.
Every line here is a team someone voted for.
brackets-complete: That's the cup complete. Thanks for playing with me.
That's a wrap. Great run. I'll miss the crowd noise.
We have a champion. Worth every game.
brackets-empty: No bracket yet. Nobody's been seeded.
Blank board. Seeding hasn't been announced yet.
Blank lobby for now. Come back later.
